Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness Training: in accordance with the DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart H.
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness with Function-Specific Training in Packaging & Labeling: in accordance with 49 CFR Parts 171–180, Hazardous Materials Regulations (HMR), U.S. DOT/PHMSA.
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation 10-Hour Advanced General Awareness Training: in accordance with the DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Parts 171 to 180.
  • DOT HAZMAT Transportation Supervisor Training for Highway: in accordance with DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (HMR), 49 CFR Parts 171-180.
  • DOT HAZMAT Ground Shipper Certification Training: in accordance with DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (HMR), 49 CFR Parts 171-180.
How long does DOT Hazmat Training take?
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness Training: 4 hours.
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness with Function-Specific Training in Packaging & Labeling: 5 hours.
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation 10-Hour Advanced General Awareness Training: 10 hours.
  • DOT HAZMAT Transportation Supervisor Training for Highway: 7 hours.
  • DOT HAZMAT Ground Shipper Certification Training: 8 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

The certificate is valid for 36 months before a refresher is required.

Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness Training
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness with Function-Specific Training in Packaging & Labeling
  • DOT Hazmat Transportation 10-Hour Advanced General Awareness Training
  • DOT HAZMAT Transportation Supervisor Training for Highway

The other course is in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
